summary.text: Paul Evans is a Democratic state representative from District 20 who has represented the district since January 12, 2015 and is seeking re-election.
He appears on the November 3, 2026 ballot with Democratic and Working Families Party nominations.

paragraphs.text: Paul Evans earned a B.S. in Public Policy and Administration from Western Oregon University in 1992 and an M.A. in Interdisciplinary Studies from Oregon State University in 2001.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1993 to 1997 and in the Oregon Air National Guard from 1997 to July 2010.

His professional experience includes work as a volunteer fireman with the Polk County Fire District #1, as a teacher at Western Oregon University, Chemeketa Community College and Oregon State University, and as president of Northwest Passage Trading Company.
Evans served as mayor of Monmouth from January 1999 to December 2002.

In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Veterans and Emergency Management, Joint Transportation, and Joint Ways and Means committees; in 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 he chaired the Veterans and Emergency Management Committee.
